description: This file implements GPU-accelerated histogram operations for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend within PyTorch. It defines kernel implementations and dispatching mechanisms for multi-dimensional histograms, including support for weights and density normalization, and interacts with Metal shader libraries for GPU execution.

classes.name: BIN_SELECTION_ALGORITHM
classes.description: Enumeration defining the algorithms for bin selection in the histogramming process, including linear interpolation and binary search.

methods.name: histogramdd_kernel_impl
methods.description: Template function implementing the core GPU-accelerated multi-dimensional histogram calculation using Metal shaders, supporting weights and different bin selection algorithms.

methods.name: histogramdd_out_mps_template
methods.description: Template function that prepares input data and invokes the GPU kernel to compute the histogram, with optional density normalization.

methods.name: histogramdd
methods.description: Entry point for computing a multi-dimensional histogram using Metal shaders, handles optional weighting and density normalization.

methods.name: histogramdd_linear_kernel
methods.description: Wrapper for the linear interpolation variant of multi-dimensional histogram calculation.

methods.name: histogram_select_outer_bin_edges_kernel
methods.description: Kernel to select outer bin edges by computing min and max values across input tensor.
